title: PPT Design
description: Deck-wide visual direction, layout preferences, and shared decoration placement.

direction.description: Deck-wide visual intent for page authoring, such as mood or preferred visual expression. Keep content requirements in Manifest and theme tokens outside this field; use an empty string when no direction is specified.

decorations.description: Shared decoration positions. Text is derived from presentation resources; Runtime and the theme control appearance. Avoid assigning visible decorations to the same position.

page_number.description: Placement of the numeric page number derived from outline order. It is always shown, including on cover and conclusion pages; none is not allowed.

section_title.description: Placement of the current top-level section title from the outline, not the subsection title. Use none to hide it; missing text is not rendered.

deck_title.description: Placement of the presentation title from Manifest.title. Use none to hide it; missing text is not rendered.

key_message.description: Placement of the current page's core message from its Spec.key_message. Use none to hide it; missing text is not rendered.

layout_preferences.description: Deck-wide composition preferences to guide page authoring. Supplying this list replaces it completely; use [] to clear it.

items.description: One actionable layout preference, such as reading order, alignment, spacing or use of charts; not a theme token or a content requirement.

x-agent-example.direction: 以结构示意图和流程关系解释概念
